effect.sauce.rage.description: Increased attack damage. If applied to a mob, forces that mob to seek out any nearby living entity and attack it.
effect.sauce.contingency.description: Applied from a spell with one of several Glyphs of Contingency. The exact effect depends on the which Glyph of Contingency was used, as well as the rest of the spell
effect.sauce.mana_cost_down.description: Mana cost of spells is reduced by 15% per level.
effect.sauce.spell_crit_up.description: Chance of spell crit is increased by 15% per level.
